in_marathi.name: Roshan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Roshan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ruchi' which means 'radiance'. The name Roshan is often given to boys born during the auspicious period of Diwali or Dipavali, the Hindu festival of lights.

in_bengali.name: Roshan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Light, Radiant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Roshan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ruchi' which means 'radiance'. The name Roshan is often given to boys born during the auspicious period of Diwali or Dipavali, the Hindu festival of lights.
